public_rationale: Read plainly, 'persist' means the weaknesses were still present in late 2024, not that there was no progress. Late-2024 evidence shows they were. Apple researchers found that adding one irrelevant clause cut accuracy by up to 65% across state-of-the-art models (e1). On OpenAI's SimpleQA factuality test, the best models answered only about 38–43% correctly (e2). ARC Prize said even o3 still failed some very easy tasks (e3). There is real counterevidence of progress: o3's December 2024 ARC-AGI score was a 'step-function' gain (e4). Still, o3 was not released then, and the same source says its weaknesses remained.
limitations: Compositionality was not separately measured in a cited late-2024 study.
SimpleQA is adversarially built, so low scores partly reflect question selection.
Whether the weaknesses are fundamental is a further claim this assessment does not test.
